Create a NEW sprite atlas of VICENTE ZAVARCE, the Venezuelan founder of Yummy, recognizable from the two supplied real photographs. The first photograph is the primary face/eyeglasses reference; the second confirms his face and actual distinctive light-colored jacket. He is a young adult man with fair warm skin, a long oval face, prominent thick dark eyebrows, dark eyes behind BLACK RECTANGULAR OPTICAL GLASSES, abundant dark brown hair swept back with height and natural waves, a straight defined nose, and a neatly trimmed dark mustache connected to a short full beard along the jaw. Preserve his real handsome lean features and expressive confident face, not the face of another fighter. No grey hair and no balding.

Use in every pose a LIGHT ICE-BLUE YUMMY ROCKET ZIP JACKET as in the second real photo, with a PURPLE ZIPPER and one small PURPLE ROCKET EMBLEM on the chest, open enough to show a BLACK CREW-NECK T-SHIRT, dark charcoal jeans, clean pale sneakers, and a simple wristwatch. The jacket is a lightweight casual zip jacket, not armor or a delivery backpack. This outfit is adapted directly from his real photo. No visible words or labels on the jacket, only the small rocket symbol. The black rectangular glasses remain visible in every pose.

Polished 2D cel-shaded editorial fighting-game illustration with believable photographic facial anatomy, restrained caricature, clear ink contours and natural adult proportions. Match the supplied EXISTING game atlas only for painting style, body scale, cell layout, poses and transparency; do not borrow its face, age, glasses or clothes. Not anime, not superhero, not exaggerated muscles.

Produce a landscape 2:1 TRANSPARENT ALPHA animation atlas containing EXACTLY EIGHT ISOLATED COMPLETE FULL-BODY figures, four equal columns by two equal rows. One figure per cell, with generous transparent gutters and outer margins. Keep every head, fist, finger and foot inside its own cell, especially the extended kick. All poses face screen right in three-quarter view with the face visible. The same recognizable person, head scale, facial features, hairstyle and clothing in all eight cells. Align planted feet at a consistent baseline within each row.

Order left to right, top then bottom: (1) idle ready stance, hands lightly raised and the face clearly visible, (2) guarded block, (3) running stride left leg forward, (4) running stride right leg forward, visibly different from the previous cell, (5) airborne jump with knees tucked, (6) straight right-handed punch, (7) high side kick to the right with the other foot planted, (8) recoiling hurt pose leaning backward but still facing right.

Completely transparent background. No floor, ground shadows, labels, writing, grid lines, borders, extra people, floating objects, particles, swooshes, effects, blurred motion, detached limbs or cropped extremities. Eight clean connected silhouettes.

Create a NEW sprite atlas of PEDRO VALLENILLA, the Venezuelan founder of Cashea, recognizable from the two supplied real photographs. The first photo is the primary facial likeness reference and the second provides his actual clothing. He is an adult man with fair warm skin, a VERY HIGH BROAD FOREHEAD and pronounced receding hairline with a large exposed upper forehead/top, short brown hair at the sides and back combed sideways, dark expressive eyebrows, dark eyes, a medium straight nose, a neatly trimmed dark mustache connected to a SHORT FULL BEARD around the jaw and chin, and a recognizable friendly broad smile. Natural adult build, not muscular. He does NOT wear glasses. Keep the prominent receding hairline rather than giving him a youthful full head of hair. His face must remain distinct from Vicente Zavarce and Henrique Capriles.

Use in every pose the LIGHT BLUE AND WHITE SMALL-CHECK BUTTON-DOWN SHIRT seen in the second real photo, open collar with sleeves rolled to the elbows, dark navy trousers, simple dark belt and white casual sneakers. Keep the checked fabric pattern coherent and consistent across poses. No business suit, no branded superhero outfit, no glasses, no hat, no watch added. These are fighting poses of the real man wearing his actual casual shirt.
